rdfs:label: contains
rdfs:comment: Links an LDP container to a resource it contains (server-managed containment triple). In Solid, containment follows the slash-delimited URI hierarchy, whether the child was created by POST, PUT or PATCH.
notes: LDP containment with HTTP semantics, managed by the server: creating a resource under a container (POST to it, or PUT/PATCH to a child URI, which also auto-creates intermediate containers) adds the `ldp:contains` triple. Unlike `urn:solid:hasPart` (a logical part-of), `contains` reflects actual server-side parent-child storage. Containment is not membership: in Direct/Indirect containers the membership triples defined by `urn:solid:hasMemberRelation` are separate from `ldp:contains`.

history.note: Definition: containment follows URI hierarchy (POST/PUT/PATCH); distinguished from membership triples.
